title: Mabdaʾ u Maʿād ('Origin and Return')

date.basis: MK: 'completed early Ṣafar 832/mid-November 1428' at Manzil-i Chālū; the same time and place as the Majlis 10196 colophon (ff. 266b-71a), but the folio lies in the second half, whose dates MK assumes are more likely composition (p.79); not asterisked.

addressee: Shāh Rażī l-Dīn, at whose request it was written
occasion: Written at a request for a mystical overview of the contemporary terrain of the religious sciences.
manuscript: 13 items listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 266b-71a (Chalu, Ṣafar 832/Nov 1428); then MS 5423 (842/1439), Bāqir Riqqat majmūʿa (901/1496), MS 10004 (903-4/1497-98), and later copies.
summary: An overview of origin and return in an introduction on the divisions of the human type, two chapters (exoteric, then Sufi) and an epilogue.
